messages:
dmitri: spotting a high rate of requests hitting edge-proxy from a tight IP range, spikes started ~10m ago. 5xxs are low but rate is causing token queueing for some customers

alice: can you paste the top src IPs / ASNs?

dmitri: top IPs: 45.132.10.*/45.132.11.* (same /23), ASN 39742. Pattern: repeated small prompt requests with identical UA: `RedBot/1.2`

ben: probably automated scraping / abuse. Let's not block blindly—some customers on the same IP ranges? check account mapping.

carol: I see 3 customer API keys with requests proxied from those IPs. Two are our internal test accounts, one is external (cust-eta). Reached out to cust-eta to verify.

alice: action plan: 1) apply soft rate limit (429 after 200 req/min per IP) at edge layer 2) push WAF rule to challenge requests with UA `RedBot/` 3) circuit-breaker for API key with >500 req/min 4) monitor error/backpressure

ben: agree. I'll craft a WAF rule. propose a staged rule: block => challenge => monitor. start with challenge (403 -> 401 challenge or captcha) then escalate.

alice: implementing per-ip 200 rpm via edge-config now. will roll in 1m.

incident-bot: edge-config deployment started by alice (deploy/12345).

alice: deployed. initial drop in sustained connection count ~30%.

carol: cust-eta says they did not initiate traffic. their app keys may have leaked. Sending them recommended rotation steps now.

ben: WAF rule draft (will push as `waf-rule-ua-redbot-challenge`):
```
match: request.headers['user-agent'] =~ /RedBot\//
action: challenge
log: true
```

ben: also adding a rule to rate-limit identical payload hashes to prevent replay floods (cache keyed by sha256(body) + ip).

alice: I've added a temporary API-key circuit-breaker: API_KEY throttle to 500 rpm with auto-suspend and alert to sec-oncall.

dmitri: testing: `curl -H "User-Agent: RedBot/1.2" -k https://api.redwood.ai/health` getting 403 challenge now. good.

emma-support: drafting customer notice for any customers affected by slow token generation: short message to send to cust-eta and to status page. will include signposting to rotate keys and how to request support.

carol: cust-eta rotated key and traffic subsided for them. still seeing other IPs in same ASN continuing but lower volume.

ben: recommend adding permanent WAF rule to block UA patterns + ASN 39742 as a temporary blocklist until we see normalcy. propose 24h block with whitelist path for known customers.

alice: am fine with ASN block for 24h but keep canary for monitoring. Deploying block now with explicit whitelist for known customer IPs.

incident-bot: edge-config deployment completed by alice (deploy/12346).

alice: telemetry update: total token latency median back to baseline, tail improved from 2.4s to 1.1s after rules.

ben: follow-ups: 1) add alert for sudden single-ASN surge (existing alerts are IP-top-N only) 2) add runbook step to check API key leakage vs internal tests 3) add automated API-key rotation script for support to run with customer consent

carol: support action items: ensure we have playbook steps for communicating key rotation, and a template for status page/incidents. Emma to finalize copy.

emma-support: status message posted to status.redwood.ai under "degraded throughput" and emailed cust-eta. template stored in docs/incidents/templates/edge-abuse.md

dmitri: assigning post-incident review to eng-sre + sec to investigate root cause (botnet vs crawler) and to verify if any other customers were impacted.

alice: I'll open a JIRA for the ASN alert and the permanent WAF tuning tasks.

ben: small snippet for prod WAF rule we'll add after review:
```
{
  "name": "block-asn-39742",
  "conditions": [
    {"type": "asn", "value": "39742"},
    {"type": "request.path", "op": "starts_with", "value": "/v1/"}
  ],
  "action": "block",
  "duration": "24h",
  "whitelist_ips": ["3.14.159.26"]
}
```

carol: all done on support comms. cust-eta confirmed rotation and backlog cleared.

dmitri: closing operational actions for now. we'll keep the block for 24h and reassess in postmortem. thanks all :thumbsup:

emma-support: please add the customer follow-up note to the incident ticket and mark SLA impact as low (brief queueing only).

alice: created postmortem draft and assigned to dmitri/ben/carol for edits. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8921

ben: postmortem TODOs: add detection rule, add WAF rule library entry, add incident summary to security runbook.

incident-bot: incident INC-8921 status changed to "postmortem-draft" by alice."
